title: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64
why_read: A named remote code execution vulnerability in OpenJDK's Base64 handling is directly relevant to anyone running Java in production.
analysis: This refers to a security vulnerability nicknamed 'Java4Shell', implying a serious remote-code-execution bug in OpenJDK's Base64 decoding, echoing the severity branding of the infamous Log4Shell flaw. If accurate, this would affect a huge number of Java-based backend systems and deserves fast patching attention from engineers. The community discussion volume suggests real technical engagement, likely including proof-of-concept exploit details and affected version ranges.
